svg.data-weight-note: 37 lb (17 kg) with one AC power supply (Table 5)
svg.data-sfp-plus-speeds: 10 GbE or 1 GbE on each fixed SFP+ port
svg.data-expansion-ports: up to 8 more SFP+ ports with two 4-port uplink modules
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 120 VAC and 200 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 12 A and 6 A
svg.data-power-input-dc: operating range -42 to -60 VDC, nominal -48 VDC, 30 A maximum
svg.data-power-supply-output: 1000 W at 100 to 120 VAC and 1200 W at 200 to 240 VAC; 1200 W on DC
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load sharing; do not mix AC and DC, or front-to-back and back-to-front
svg.data-fans: one fan tray with five fans; the switch runs 30 seconds while the tray is replaced
svg.data-altitude: no loss of performance to 10,000 ft (3,048 m)
svg.data-software: Junos OS, first release 10.2R1 for the -FB and -BF models
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches mixed with EX4200 and EX4550; the Virtual Chassis module or SFP+ ports as VCPs
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10 GbE SFP+ and 1 GbE SFP in any port
svg.data-expansion: two uplink module slots, each one 4-port SFP+ module; the rear slot takes the intraconnect or the Virtual Chassis module
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 management port with link and status lamps
